title: CASPER CLIMB
oneLiner: Climb the haunted construction tower, dodge Casper's rolling spooks, and rescue your friend at the top!
mechanics: The player starts on the bottom platform and climbs four vertically stacked platforms using left/right movement and ladders; screen remains fixed while the tower is fully visible.
A jumps with a short fixed arc when on a platform, letting the player clear small gaps and roll hazards; jumping is unavailable while climbing a ladder.
B swings the player's hammer for 10 frames: 3-frame startup, 3-frame active hit window, 4-frame recovery. It hits one nearby rolling ghost orb once and awards 100 points.

Casper throws one rolling ghost orb every 2.2 seconds from the top, aimed along the current platform route; each orb rolls to an edge, drops to the next platform, then continues. Casper telegraphs with a raised arm for 18 frames and cannot throw during 24 frames of recovery.

The first 15 seconds use a safe teaching cadence: one slow orb, a reachable ladder, and a nearby bonus bell. Later stages add one orb at a time, capped at three simultaneous orbs, with speed increasing from 55 to 78 pixels per second.

Platforms have alternating short gaps and ladders; a jump across a gap or hammer strike is the skillful way to maintain progress and score. A bell on each stage awards 500 points and briefly freezes hazards for 45 frames.

Reaching the cage at the top completes the stage, awards 2000 points, restores one missed life up to a maximum of three, and advances to a remixed tower with ladder locations shifted and a faster Casper cadence.

Contact with a rolling orb or falling through a platform gap costs one life, plays a flashing knockback animation, and restarts the player at the bottom with hazards reset; three lost lives ends the game.

After every stage, show a brief stage-clear banner and preserve the score; after stage four, show a rescue ending and final score. All hazards, timers, pickups and score awards reset deterministically on life loss or new game.
artDirection: 256x224 fixed-screen construction tower with four wide orange-brown platforms spanning the playfield, ladders in bright yellow, dark blue sky and muted brick/building silhouettes behind it. The player is a 16x24 pixel climber with a red cap, blue shirt, pale face, and two-frame walk cycle; show a crouched jump pose, arms-up ladder pose, and distinct flattened hurt pose. Casper is a large 32x32 translucent white cartoon ghost at the top, with a rounded sheet silhouette, blue-gray outline, expressive black eyes, and a friendly-but-mischievous grin; animate a hover bob and throwing pose. Haunted rolling hazards are 12x12 pale-purple ghost orbs with tiny faces, clearly separated from brown ladders and platforms. Keep active lanes high contrast and backgrounds low-detail; rescue target is a bright 20x20 character in a gold cage at the top.

preserve: Four compact construction-site platforms with ladders and gaps
A vertical climb toward a captive character at the top
Barrels rolling down platforms as the signature hazard
A large top-platform antagonist and a clear stage-by-stage rescue goal
Arcade platforming with immediate movement, jumping, score pickups and limited lives
change: Replace Donkey with Casper as the top antagonist
Use Casper as a friendly cartoon ghost who throws and guides haunted objects rather than a gorilla throwing barrels
Keep the player as a climbing rescuer pursuing the top-of-stage captive, with Casper as the obstacle and encounter identity

controls.left: Move left on platforms; steer left while airborne; climb down a ladder when overlapping it.
controls.right: Move right on platforms; steer right while airborne; climb up a ladder when overlapping it.
controls.up: Climb upward while overlapping a ladder; otherwise no action.
controls.down: Climb downward while overlapping a ladder; otherwise no action.
controls.a: Jump when standing on a platform; unavailable while climbing.
controls.b: Swing hammer when standing or moving on a platform; unavailable while climbing or airborne.

lose: Lose one of three lives by touching a rolling ghost orb or falling through a platform gap; the game ends when all lives are gone.
scoring: Score 100 for each ghost orb smashed, 500 for each bell, 2000 for reaching the cage, with no repeated score from one collision.
